name: Classic Sourdough Loaf
description: Our signature 48-hour fermented sourdough with a crisp golden crust and an open, chewy crumb.
details: Slow fermented for 48 hours and baked in a deck oven. Best eaten within two days, and it freezes well sliced.

name: Seeded Rye Loaf
description: A dense, hearty rye bread packed with sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds.
details: A moist rye loaf with a deep, tangy flavour. A favourite for open sandwiches, smoked fish and strong cheese.

name: Ciabatta Rolls (4-pack)
description: Light, airy ciabatta rolls with a thin crust, ideal for lunch rolls and bruschetta.
details: Soft inside and crisp outside. Pack of four, perfect for sandwiches or to serve with soup.

name: Whole Wheat Loaf
description: Stone-ground whole wheat loaf with a soft crumb and a mild nutty flavour.
details: Made with stone-ground flour from local farms. Available sliced or unsliced.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Classic croissant made with real butter and three days of lamination. Flaky and golden.
details: Laminated by hand over three days. Best eaten on the day it is baked, warmed for a few minutes if you can wait.

name: Pain au Chocolat
description: A croissant dough pocket with two generous fingers of Belgian dark chocolate.
details: Baked until deeply caramelised so the chocolate stays soft in the middle.

name: Almond Danish
description: Laminated pastry filled with almond frangipane and topped with flaked almonds and a light glaze.
details: A buttery danish with a soft almond centre and a crisp, flaky edge.

name: Lemon Tart (slice)
description: A buttery shortcrust shell filled with sharp, silky lemon curd and dusted with icing sugar.
details: Sold by the slice in store. Whole tarts for gatherings can be ordered through the enquiry form.

name: Birthday Cake
description: Round cakes in 6, 8 or 10 inch sizes in vanilla, chocolate, red velvet or carrot cake.
details: Designed with you and baked to order. Choose your flavour, filling, colours and a message for the top.
availability: Order at least 5 business days ahead

name: Wedding Cake
description: Multi-tier wedding cakes with floral decoration, fondant finishes or semi-naked buttercream.
details: Every wedding cake starts with a tasting and consultation so we can match your colours, theme and guest numbers.

name: Baby Shower Cake
description: Elegant, gender-reveal-ready cakes with pastel decoration and a surprise coloured sponge inside.
details: Fully customisable, from soft pastels to bold colours, with toppers made to match your party theme.
availability: Order at least 5 business days ahead
